exposure: Type of language development disorder (comprehension and expression disorder, articulation disorder, mixed)
cohort: 240 children aged 0-3 years diagnosed with DLD out of 1500 children screened
finding: Neonatal factors, followed by fetal and maternal factors, were the main contributors to language development disorder in children in Ningxia.
mod_finding: This study found that delivery mode was a factor influencing language development in children.
